answer: Split each epoch's work through a prism: the network assigns every identity a random task from a wide spectrum of skills, and it earns only by completing tasks outside its one registered specialty. Clones share a single narrow mind, so a farm passes only one colour of the beam; covering the whole spectrum needs genuinely different capabilities, and each new clone must master new domains from scratch. Every completed task hangs in a public lantern log, so single-skill identities stand out, and like a juniper, standing grows slowly through seasons of diverse, visible work.
